question: On 8 July 2024, Prime Minister Narendra Modi began a high-profile visit to which of the following countries?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Russia**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• On 8 July 2024, Prime Minister Narendra Modi began a high-profile visit to **Russia** to strengthen bilateral relations and discuss strategic partnerships.
 
• India and Russia share a **long-standing friendship and strategic partnership** across various sectors, including defense, energy, trade, and space exploration.
 
• During the visit, discussions were focused on cooperation in areas such as **civil nuclear energy, defense manufacturing, and regional stability**.
 
• Russia is one of India's most important partners in the BRICS grouping and SCO (Shanghai Cooperation Organization).
 
• India and Russia have collaborated on various defense projects, including the **BrahMos missile**, and Russia remains one of the largest suppliers of defense equipment to India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Bilateral Trade:** India and Russia aim to increase their bilateral trade to $30 billion by 2025, focusing on energy, pharmaceuticals, and defense.
 
• **Defense Cooperation:** Russia is a major supplier of military equipment to India, including fighter jets, submarines, and missile systems, contributing to India's defense capabilities.
 
• **Energy Partnership:** India imports crude oil from Russia and collaborates in the development of nuclear power plants, such as the Kudankulam Nuclear Power Plant.
 
• **BRICS Grouping:** Both nations are active members of BRICS, a grouping of emerging economies (Brazil, Russia, India, China, South Africa) aiming to enhance cooperation in global governance and economic development.
 
• **Historical Ties:** India and Russia have shared strong historical ties since the Soviet era, with Russia supporting India's industrialization and space programs in the early 20th century.
